concerns.text: The specification requires a CPU‑only inference constraint (FR‑008) and the evaluation pipeline (T013) does not include a CUDA‑guard. Without an explicit check that `torch.cuda.is_available()` aborts, the evaluation could run on GPU, violating the constitution’s CPU‑only inference principle.

Reproducibility (SC‑001) mandates consistent random‑seed management across all scripts. The tasks create a seed file (T004) but the extraction (T010), training (T012), and evaluation (T013) scripts do not explicitly set or record the seed, making the reproducibility claim untestable.
